lede: The clearest signal today is a single Wikipedia article: Christa Pike drew 1,334,670 views, roughly 3.7 times the next entry on the list. Sport carries most of the rest of the public's attention, with the 2026 Asian Games taking three of Wikipedia's top five slots and searches for India against Sri Lanka filling three of Google's five trending queries. On Hacker News, Google's Gemini 4 Argon leads with 1,166 points and 769 comments.
